messages:
Priya: Quick OKR pulse — short async check on Q2 milestones. Please reply with one-line updates: what shipped, what slipped, immediate blockers, and owner.

Maria: Runtime team shipped prefix KV-cache caching to canary yesterday. p95 token latency down ~15% on the sampled workloads. Rolling at 20% traffic. :tada:

Kevin: Confirmed. PR #4821 merged for caching. Note: PR #4823 (quantization tuning) needs reviews from @Alex and @Jamie before we push canary to 50%.

Alex: I can take #4823 now — two small comments so far, expect to finish reviews by EOD.

Jon: Infra flag — Dedicated autoscaler bug still prevents stable >2k rps for a single pool. Hotfix branch opened, CI failing on the rollback case. ETA for fix: tomorrow AM. @Maria this blocks ramp beyond 20%.

Maria: Acknowledged. We'll hold at 20% until autoscale is validated.

Liza: QA: found a flaky evictions test on long-context path (fails ~1/20 runs). Filed bug #1138 with repro steps. Tagging @Kevin for triage.

Kevin: Thanks Liza — I'll triage after finishing the code review. If it's test-only we can merge with a skip and followup.

Priya: Callout: telemetry retention & cost dashboard didn't make this sprint (slip). Owner for analytics is @Rachel — can you share ETA and blocker?

Rachel: Yep, slipping due to infra schema changes and shipping blocker from autoscale. New ETA is Fri next week; coordinating with Jon to finish the log shipper work.

Jon: Also need a permissions tweak on the test cluster to validate retention. @Sara-ops can you grant the analytics service account the new read role so we can run e2e?

Sara-ops: On it — will grant and confirm tomorrow morning.

Priya: OK — owners summary for next steps: runtime = Maria; infra = Jon; analytics = Rachel; docs = Ben. Immediate blockers: autoscaler fix (Jon), flaky eviction test (Liza -> Kevin), schema+shipper (Rachel+Jon). CR pings: @Alex, @Jamie for #4823; please ack.

Eng-bot: deploybot: "Canary rollout unchanged — runtime-v3-canary @ 20% (at 1725010200)"

Kevin: Quick reviewer ping for #4823: Alex, Jamie, Sam if available. Need two approvers to proceed.

Alex: ACK — will finish review in ~2 hours.

Jamie: On PTO until ~6pm PT, will check when back but can try to approve if small.

Priya: Thanks everyone. If any other slips or new blockers pop up, ping me directly. Otherwise we'll recheck sync tomorrow morning. :pray:
